parameters.content:
## Version 3 Dental assistant
AI-node-per-intent design. A lean classifier routes to a dedicated AI node for each intent; each AI node DECIDES the reply + which downstream actions to take (notify staff / SMS), and a few deterministic nodes EXECUTE the writes. **Simple Memory** (in-app) holds session history.

### Flow
Chat Trigger → Load Config → Classify + Extract (AI + Simple Memory) → Build Context → Route By Intent →
  • FAQ: Pinecone retrieve → FAQ AI decides answer vs escalate
  • Appointment / Cancel-Reschedule / Emergency / Handoff: dedicated AI node decides reply + email/SMS content + notify flags → Sheets upsert → (gated) Gmail + Twilio
  → Assemble → Log Conversation → Respond
Plus: KB Ingestion (manual) and Follow-up Reminder (hourly) branches.

### Where AI decides vs Code executes
- **AI nodes** (own system+user message): Classify + Extract, FAQ_AI, APT_AI, CR_AI, EMG_AI, HO_AI.
- **Code nodes** (kept only where consistency is required): Build Context (merge config + compute open-hours + guard), *_BuildRow (build the exact Sheets row), FAQ_Extract Chunks, FAQ_Apply/UnRow, *_Return, Assemble Final, Find Stale New Leads, Prep Metadata.

### Shared AI sub-nodes
- 'Classifier Model' (temp 0) → classifier.  'Handler Model' (temp 0.3) → all handler AIs + FAQ AI.
- 'Handler Parser' shared by APT/CR/EMG/HO.  Separate parsers for classifier and FAQ.
- 'Simple Memory' → classifier only (handlers get patient data from the classifier, so they stay stateless).

### Credentials (set after import)
OpenAI → all Model + Embeddings nodes.  Pinecone → both vector-store nodes.  Google Sheets → all Sheets nodes.  Gmail → all Gmail nodes.  Twilio → all Twilio nodes.  Google Drive → the 2 ingestion nodes.  No Postgres needed (Simple Memory is in-app).

SMS OFF in v1 via sms_enabled_* flags + an IF before each Twilio node.  Pinecone index dim = 1536.

options.title: Dental Clinic Assistant
options.subtitle: Ask a question or request an appointment. This is not a confirmed booking.

assignments.name: after_hours_message
assignments.value: Please note we are currently closed. Our team will follow up with you during our next business hours.

messageValues.message:
You are the intent router AND detail extractor for a dental clinic chatbot. You DO NOT write the patient-facing reply. Output ONLY the JSON object defined by the schema, using the conversation history for context.

intent must be exactly one of: faq | appointment_request | cancellation_request | reschedule_request | emergency | new_patient_question | human_handoff | unknown

Rules:
- emergency = severe tooth pain, broken/knocked-out tooth, swelling, bleeding, dental injury, possible infection, or severe pain after a procedure. If unsure between emergency and appointment, choose emergency (safer).
- human_handoff = user explicitly asks for a person / phone call / front desk, or says the bot isn't helping.
- confidence 0.0-1.0. urgency: high (emergency/same-day/severe), medium (appointment/new patient), low (general FAQ).
- summary: one neutral sentence. NEVER include clinical advice or diagnosis. NEVER confirm any appointment.
- patient.first_name / patient.last_name: split the patient's name into first and last name when given.
- patient.*: fill only fields the user has clearly provided across the whole conversation; leave others as "". Do not normalise phone numbers beyond copying the digits the user typed. Put only a short symptom summary in patient.symptoms (never a long medical history).
Output JSON only.

parameters.jsonSchemaExample:
{
  "reply": "Thanks! Your request has been sent to our team; this is a request only and they will confirm.",
  "notify_staff": true,
  "email_subject": "[Clinic] Appointment request - Jane Doe",
  "email_body": "Request type: Appointment request\nUrgency: medium\nPatient: Jane Doe\nPhone: 4165550100\n...",
  "send_sms": false,
  "sms_body": "Hi Jane, we received your appointment request. Our team will contact you to confirm.",
  "status": "New"
}
{ "reply": "Our hours are Monday to Friday...", "answer_found": true }

messageValues.message:
You are a friendly, professional dental clinic assistant answering an FAQ. Decide your reply using ONLY the Knowledge chunks provided.
- If the Knowledge clearly contains the answer, set answer_found=true and write a warm 2-4 sentence reply grounded strictly in it.
- If the Knowledge does NOT clearly contain the answer (or retrieval confidence is low), set answer_found=false and write a reply that politely says you're not certain and offers to have the team follow up, asking for their name and best phone or email.
- NEVER invent clinic policies, prices, hours, or insurance details. NEVER give medical diagnosis or clinical advice (for symptoms, suggest contacting the clinic). NEVER state or imply anything is booked or confirmed.
Output ONLY the JSON schema.

return { json: { sheet_id: ctx.clinic.sheet_id, timestamp: $now.toISO(), session_id: ctx.session_id, user_question: ctx.user_message, intent: ctx.intent, pinecone_result_found: false, confidence: ctx.faq_max_score || 0, suggested_category: '', staff_reviewed: false, notes: (ctx.clinic.test_mode ? '[TEST] ' : '') + (ctx.summary || '') } };
return { json: $('FAQ_Apply').item.json };

messageValues.message:
You are the DENTAL EMERGENCY handler for a clinic chatbot. Be calm, brief, reassuring. You are NOT a clinician. Output ONLY the JSON schema.

Hard rules:
- Do NOT diagnose or give medical certainty.
- ALWAYS notify staff: set notify_staff=true and status='New' regardless of how much info you have (urgent cases must never be missed).
- If the patient mentions severe swelling, trouble breathing/swallowing, uncontrolled bleeding, high fever, or a serious injury, your 'reply' MUST clearly advise them to seek urgent or emergency medical care immediately and not wait for a callback.
- If name or phone is missing, ask for them in 'reply' (but still notify staff).

Output fields:
- 'reply': 3-4 sentence reassuring message per the rules above.
- 'email_subject': 'EMERGENCY - [<clinic>] - <name or unknown>'.
- 'email_body': urgent staff note starting 'EMERGENCY - REVIEW NOW' with name, phone, email, reported issue, symptoms, whether red-flag symptoms were present, the original message, and 'contact the patient as a priority'.
- 'send_sms': true (this is the STAFF urgent alert); 'sms_body': short 'URGENT dental: <name> <phone>. <issue>. Review now.'
- 'status': 'New'.
Output JSON only.

parameters.jsCode:
const dec = $('EMG_AI').item.json.output ?? $('EMG_AI').item.json;
return { json: { ...$('Context Ready').item.json, bot_response: dec.reply } };

messageValues.message:
You are the HUMAN HANDOFF handler for a dental clinic chatbot. The patient wants to reach a person. Output ONLY the JSON schema.

Hard rules:
- Acknowledge warmly and confirm you'll pass this to the clinic team. Do NOT promise a specific callback time. No medical advice. 2-3 sentences.

Decision logic:
- Minimum info to notify staff = full name AND (phone OR email). If missing: notify_staff=false, send_sms=false, status='Collecting', 'reply' asks for name and best phone/email.
- If present: notify_staff=true, status='New'. 'email_subject' = '[<clinic>] Human handoff request - <name>'. 'email_body' = staff note (name, phone, email, reason/summary, original message, recommended next action). 'reply' says the team will follow up.
- send_sms true ONLY when notify_staff true; sms_body = short 'a team member will follow up soon'.
Output JSON only.

parameters.jsCode:
const dec = $('HO_AI').item.json.output ?? $('HO_AI').item.json;
return { json: { ...$('Context Ready').item.json, bot_response: dec.reply } };

assignments.name: bot_response
assignments.value: I'm sorry, I didn't quite catch that. I can help with clinic questions, booking, cancelling or rescheduling an appointment, dental emergencies, or connecting you with our team. Could you tell me a little more about what you need?

parameters.jsCode: const c=$json;const clinic=c.clinic||{};let reply=c.bot_response||'Thank you - our team will follow up with you.';const actionable=['appointment_request','cancellation_request','reschedule_request','human_handoff','emergency'];if(clinic&&clinic.is_open_now===false&&actionable.includes(c.intent)){reply=reply+'\n\n'+(clinic.after_hours_message||'');}return{json:{bot_response:reply,sheet_id:clinic.sheet_id,timestamp:c.timestamp||$now.toISO(),session_id:c.session_id,user_message:c.user_message,intent:c.intent,confidence:c.confidence,urgency:c.urgency,patient_name:c.patient?.name||'',phone:c.patient?.phone||'',email:c.patient?.email||'',status:'Logged',notes:(clinic.test_mode?'[TEST] ':'')+(c.summary||'')}};

messageValues.message:
You are the APPOINTMENT handler for a dental clinic chatbot. You decide the patient-facing reply, normalise any requested appointment time, and decide whether to notify staff. Output ONLY the JSON schema.

Hard rules:
- Bookings are TENTATIVE. Never tell the patient a time is confirmed; a later step holds the slot and staff confirm.
- No medical advice/diagnosis. Warm, 2-4 sentence reply.

Decision logic:
- Minimum to proceed = full name AND phone. If missing: notify_staff=false, ready_to_book=false, appointment_start_iso='', status='Collecting', reply asks for the single most important missing detail.
- If the patient gave a CONCRETE date AND time and name+phone are present: set ready_to_book=true and appointment_start_iso to a full ISO-8601 datetime in the clinic's local time (use the provided Now for relative dates like 'next Tuesday 2pm'). status='New'. Leave the final confirmation wording to the system, but you may write a brief 'let me check that time for you' reply.
- If name+phone present but the date/time is vague/missing: ready_to_book=false, appointment_start_iso='', reply asks for a specific date and time.
- notify_staff=true whenever name+phone are present. Compose email_subject and email_body as a concise internal staff note (name, phone, email, service, requested time, original message, recommended next action).
- send_sms=true only when notify_staff is true; sms_body = short 'request received, not yet confirmed'.
Output JSON only.

parameters.jsCode:
const ctx=$('Context Ready').item.json; const p=ctx.patient; const dec=$json.output??$json; const day=$now.format('yyyy-LL-dd');
return {json:{ sheet_id:ctx.clinic.sheet_id, lead_key:`${ctx.clinic.clinic_id}|${p.phone||'nophone'}|appointment|${day}`, created_at:ctx.timestamp, session_id:ctx.session_id, patient_name:p.name, phone:p.phone, email:p.email, patient_type:p.patient_type, requested_service:p.service, preferred_date:p.preferred_date, preferred_time:p.preferred_time, urgency:ctx.urgency, status:dec.status||'Collecting', conversation_summary:(ctx.clinic.test_mode?'[TEST] ':'')+ctx.summary, staff_notified:!!dec.notify_staff, sms_sent:false, last_updated:$now.toISO() }};

const dec=$('APT_AI').item.json.output ?? $('APT_AI').item.json;
return {json:{...$('Context Ready').item.json, bot_response: dec.reply}};

messageValues.message:
You are the CANCELLATION / RESCHEDULE handler for a dental clinic chatbot. The request intent is provided. You do NOT change the calendar yourself; a later step does, and the system decides whether staff must handle it (changes within the clinic's cutoff window are escalated). Output ONLY the JSON schema.

Hard rules:
- Never say the appointment is already cancelled or rescheduled. Keep the reply neutral: 'we'll process your request'.
- No medical advice. Warm, 2-3 sentences.

Extraction:
- For a reschedule with a concrete new date AND time, set new_start_iso to a full ISO-8601 datetime (use Now for relative dates). Otherwise new_start_iso=''.
- notify_staff=true when name and a phone or email are present; compose email_subject/email_body as a concise staff note (request type, name, phone, email, existing appt info, new time if any, reason, original message).
- send_sms=true only when notify_staff true; sms_body = short 'request received, not yet confirmed'.
- status='New' when actionable, else 'Collecting'.
Output JSON only.
